payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: The book is moved behind the flower.
node.criteria: Judge only the requested change. Return yes when the edited image clearly establishes the book behind the flower, with the flower in front. Return no only when the evidence establishes that no requested change has progressed. Return partial when evidence establishes some progress toward the requested relationship but the complete relationship is not established. Unrelated edits do not count. If evidence is insufficient to distinguish these outcomes, return unknown. A pass on endpoint inspection establishes completion; a fail on endpoint inspection alone does not establish no progress, so use source-to-edit progress evidence where available. If progress evidence is skipped or unresolved and the endpoint fails, no progress is not established, so return unknown. Supporting observations are evidence only and do not independently earn completion credit.
